# Ablation ladder — one component at a time

<!-- generated by 62_sanity_train.py + 63_audit_report.py — do not edit by hand -->

> Every arm is the same training run with exactly one switch moved, scored on a FIXED held-out set: the same months, the same seeded input draws and the same queries, so a difference is attributable to the switch.

> Selection uses 2022 (`validation`); the 2023-24 column is the held-out score of the selected weights. 2025 is untouched.

> **`qc` and `anomaly_exact` change the target itself**, so their z units are not the baseline's. Compare those two by **J** (each arm against its own climatology on its own targets); every other arm shares the baseline's target and is comparable in z.

## Satellite era — does cross-modality information buy anything?

> A SECONDARY split (train 2016-2020, validate 2021, test 2022-2023): `data/real_obs_1deg.zarr` covers 2016-2023 only, so this cannot use the `recent3` test years and its numbers never join Tables 1-8. Every arm here is trained on the same 60 months.

| region | arm | params | seeds | test TEMP (z) | test TEMP (°C) | test J TEMP | test J SALT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| gulfstream | Perceiver-IO, profiles only | 405063 | 2 | 1.0840 | 1.957 | 0.992 | 0.996 |
| gulfstream | SetConv-UNet, profiles only | 408792 | 2 | 1.0662 | 1.914 | 0.975 | 0.973 |
| gulfstream | SetConv-UNet, **+ altimetry (SLA) only** | 409352 | 2 | 0.9162 | 1.664 | 0.838 | 0.858 |
| gulfstream | SetConv-UNet, **+ satellite SST/SLA/SSS** | 409912 | 2 | 0.8883 | 1.604 | 0.813 | 0.842 |

The **altimetry-only** row is the control that matters: the L4 SST and SSS analyses assimilate in-situ data and could in principle feed a held-out float's own surface value back to the model, while altimetry never sees a profile. It reproduces most of the gain, and the gain is largest in the deepest band — the steric signature of sea level, not SST copied down.

`gulfstream` reference on this split: kriging OI (profiles only) **1.0376 z / J 0.949** at the same cap, **1.0015 z / J 0.916** with every profile; climatology 1.0930 z.

`npac_gyre` reference on this split: kriging OI (profiles only) **0.8578 z / J 0.828** at the same cap, **0.8294 z / J 0.801** with every profile; climatology 1.0360 z.
